from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and which OTHER provided papers it references in its bibliography."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title as it appears")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers (known from summaries) that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
